notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32165862/44bad253f04021fa8cd3752d9f21bf9e5fa632d5.jpg[/img]

[b]Friends! Comrades! It finally happened! The update is uploaded and should be available to everyone right now!
[/b]
The road to the multiplayer was hard and full of dangers. We encountered many setbacks, our lead developer left the team, our animator came down with the sickness, many bugs stemming from earlier poor technical decisions, some so bad, we couldn’t completely fix them till this very day.

And while we were fighting through all those setbacks, the worst thing possible happened…
People have abandoned Boobs Saga. The number of players dwindled, and we were getting close to bankruptcy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32165862/7e340c9fdb5055ba7b76ede050e329a976d0681b.jpg[/img]

But all's well that ends well. We managed to push through and build a new, solid foundation for all the new things we have planned. We have prepared new maps, fixed customization options, got rid of multitudes of bugs, and even added new modes. And this is only the beginning, our new base tech is more robust than ever, and we can keep building on it.

And now we are ready to release the game, to attract new players, to make sure that we will be able to continue working on the game. Again, this transition to the full release does not mean that we’re going to stop working on the game. On the contrary, we will be improving it faster than ever. I will not let you down, you have my word on that.

[b]You wanted more animations? I got you more animations. [/b]You want something else? I’ll add it to the game. But I will be honest here, the pace of development is going to be dependent on the reception. The more new players we get - the faster the updates will be coming in.

[b]So I ask you to tell your friends, family and neighbours about the game. And keep sending us bug reports, we want to make the game as polished as it can be.
[/b]
Thank you for playing and caring about [b]Boobs Saga![/b]

Oh, yeah, and this first batch of new multiplayer modes is all about killing other players. Kill them all and unlock one of the new artworks. Collect all new artworks - and you’ll unlock 5 unique 2d animations. And those are totally worth it, believe me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32165862/9a61939ef66979a3ac937b926f82b29781345a32.png[/img]

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32165862/ee1f80482fb2e1ddbc807599cea6cefd7100c3f3.gif[/img]

So, first things first, Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays and Season Greetings to you all! After releasing the previous update we started working on the next one. This is going to be a big one, with many new features and improvements. There will be new scenes, new artworks, various improvements in stability, controls and general gameplay.

And for the other Christmas special, I'll be doing an AMA on Reddit today at 9:00 PM PST/12:00 AM EST. Ask me anything you want to know about the development process, the game itself, or just get to know me better. I will be posting the link to the AMA when it's live.
